bugs.title: Pause menu renders very small/semi-transparent at 360x640
bugs.evidence: Screenshot pause-confirm-back-paused.png (360x640): PAUSED panel with Resume/Restart/Home is ~70px wide in the center of the road, text barely legible. Buttons still clickable via testID. Backend /api/health 200.

action_items.detail: Test runs collected 0 coins (stayed in left lane until crash), so coin +1/+10 increments and banking with non-zero coins were only verified trivially (balance delta == run coins == 0). Play Again double-bank not exercised.
Native FPS/haptics/hardware back not verifiable on web per spec_deviations.
